negativeSample.observation: Read failure fixture and confirmed the concrete false-PASS cases: SVG labels can disagree with actual primitives, enumerated subparts must be separated in rendered solution blocks, and runtime TeX escape damage requires sandbox-level checks. These cases guide review without inheriting the rejected outputs.

decision: The fixed registry is the quality floor. Use explicit source conditions, visible counting/algebra setup, sequential intermediate values, separate case blocks, and a conclusion tied to the selected answer. Do not inherit any rendering treatment that is unreadable or unverified.
